note: `numeric_parse_guard.call_arg_has_nul_at_token_end` is a semantic view over the vulnerable `strtol(str_val, &endp, 10)` call: the emitted 0/1 records whether the byte immediately after the logical token slice in the actual buffer handed to the numeric parser is an in-bounds `\0`. The vulnerable instrumentation returns 0 when that slot does not exist instead of dereferencing past the testcase buffer. The fixed instrumentation computes the same semantic view on its repaired `cbuf` copy, but bindings remain anchored to the vulnerable source expressions. `numeric_parse_guard.true_literal` is intentionally omitted because the validator treats `*.true_literal` as a compile-time literal rather than a vulnerable-source expression.
